question: Which customers each contributed 10% or more of Fabrinet's revenues in fiscal 2026 (year ended June 26, 2026), and what percentage of revenue did each represent?
grading: Key points: four customers each >=10% of FY2026 revenue: Cisco Systems 19.9%, NVIDIA 16.3%, Nokia 10.7%, Amazon.com 10.5% (together 57.4%). Accept +/-0.1pp. Fail if fewer than all four are named or if FY2025 shares (NVIDIA 27.6%, Cisco 18.2%) are given for FY2026.
answer: In fiscal 2026 (ended June 26, 2026) four customers each contributed 10% or more of Fabrinet's revenues: Cisco Systems 19.9%, NVIDIA 16.3%, Nokia 10.7% and Amazon.com 10.5%, together 57.4% of revenue. In fiscal 2025 only NVIDIA (27.6%) and Cisco (18.2%) exceeded 10% [H07-E1].
